title: The First Demon
summary: At Saint Mirren University, Ha-Jun's bullies cower before his unconscious sovereign aura. Moments later, a terrifying Greater Shadow Hound breaches the campus courtyard, targeting students. As his friend Min-Jae is about to be crushed, Ha-Jun leaps from the third story to intercept the beast.

panels.action: Wide establishing shot of Saint Mirren University in the overcast morning; crowds of students enter beneath neoclassical stone arches.
Ha-Jun walks down the brightly lit school corridor, his posture upright and confident, navy blazer immaculate.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Aaj subah... sab kuch kitna saaf dikh raha hai.

panels.action: Female classmates whisper to each other behind notebooks as Ha-Jun passes: 'Woh Ha-Jun hai na? Uski chot kahan gayi?'

dialogue.text: Dekho use... kitna alag lag raha hai aaj!

panels.action: School bully Jin-Woo (tall, athletic, smirking arrogantly) steps out from the lockers with two cronies, blocking Ha-Jun's path.

dialogue.speaker: bully_leader
dialogue.text: Arey waah, loser! Kal ki maar se bach gaya?

panels.action: Jin-Woo points a finger at Ha-Jun's chest: 'Chupchap aaj ka lunch money nikaal, warna kal se zyada bura haal karunga.'
Ha-Jun stops. His dark brown eyes lock onto Jin-Woo with absolute stillness, devoid of all fear or hesitation.
From Jin-Woo's terrified perspective, Ha-Jun's shadow distorts into a colossal 20-foot demonic behemoth with burning violet eyes.

panels.shot: bully stumbling backward in cold sweat
panels.action: Jin-Woo gasps in sudden terror, his knees buckling as he stumbles backward into the lockers, drenched in cold sweat.

dialogue.speaker: bully_leader
dialogue.text: Y-Yeh achanak saans lena itna mushkil kyun ho gaya...?!

panels.action: Ha-Jun calmly steps past the cowering bullies without uttering a single word, leaving them gasping on the floor.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Inke paas mere waqt ka ek pal bhi nahi hai.

panels.action: In the grand university library, Ha-Jun sits by a high arched window, researching ancient demonic relics in historic volumes.
Kuro's translucent spirit perches near the ceiling: 'Sahi kiya. Cheentiyon ko kuchalne mein koi shaan nahi hoti.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Cheentiyon ko ignore karna hi behtar hai.

panels.action: Suddenly, the heavy library window glass vibrates violently; books shudder on the mahogany shelves.
All electric chandeliers in the library flicker and abruptly pop out, plunging the grand room into cold unnatural gloom.
Through Ha-Jun's mana vision, creeping black frost spreads across the floorboards as temperature plummets below zero.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Yeh aam toofan nahi hai... Abyss ki sardi hai!

panels.action: Terrified screams of hundreds of students echo up from the central quadrangle below.
Ha-Jun throws his chair back, rushing to the open stone balustrade and looking down into the courtyard.
A massive 15-foot black dimensional fissure tears through the center of the brick plaza, vomiting corrosive smoke.
A terrifying 15-foot quadrupedal Shadow Hound claws its way out: Spiked obsidian bone-armor, three burning red eyes, jaws dripping black bile.
The beast roars into the sky; the acoustic shockwave shatters dozens of campus windows simultaneously.
In the courtyard below, Min-Jae trips over his fallen books, scrambling desperately backward as the beast towers over him.
The Shadow Hound raises its massive, jagged-clawed front leg to crush Min-Jae into bloody pulp.
Ha-Jun's eyes flare with incandescent violet fury: 'MIN-JAE-!!'
Ha-Jun kicks the heavy window glass into fragments, diving out from the third floor directly into the empty air.
Falling through the air, Ha-Jun channels his sovereign mana: The crystalline purple demonic gauntlet snaps around his right arm with blinding energy.
Gravity accelerates his fall into a screaming violet meteor; air pressure distorts around his diving fist.

panels.shot: beast shock three eyes look up
panels.action: The Shadow Hound's three crimson eyes snap upward in sudden disbelief, sensing the overwhelming sovereign wavelength descending upon it.
Mid-air collision: Ha-Jun's demonic gauntlet slams directly into the hound's descending paw, stopping the 15-foot beast cold in its tracks.
A 10-meter shockwave crater erupts across the brick plaza; flying debris forms a protective dome curving over Min-Jae.
Min-Jae stares up from the ground in stunned awe at the back of the student who just saved his life.
Epic standoff cliffhanger: Ha-Jun stands tall over Min-Jae, his crystalline purple gauntlet flaring with violet lightning as he glares down the snarling 15-foot beast: 'Mere dost ko chhoona bhi mat.'
